import subprocess,pathlib,os
root=os.getcwd(); nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=['python',os.path.join(root,'executable')]; cwd=os.path.join(root,'tmpcheck')
cases=['open test.txt','open data.json','open data.json | get a','echo hello','pwd','cd ..; pwd','glob *.txt','\"abc\" | save out.txt; open out.txt']
for c in cases:
 a=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run(py+['--no-config-file','-c',c],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True)
 ok=(a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)==(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr)
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'BAD'),c)
 if not ok:print('REF',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr),'GOT',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr))
'@ | python -; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\\tmpcheck"
